market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is an activist with no national electoral base, no party structure for a presidential run, and past vote shares below 0.5%. In a polarized field with major figures like Lula, Bolsonaro allies, Tebet, or Zema, the probability he finishes second is negligible, far below the market's 7.7% implied by the Yes price.
evidence_points: Santos received ~0.2% of the vote when running for federal deputy in São Paulo (2022).
No credible polling places him among top-tier 2026 presidential contenders; his name recognition is minimal.
Historical second-place finishers in Brazil are major national candidates, not fringe activists.
sources_consulted: Recent 2026 presidential polling summaries (e.g., Datafolha, Quaest)
